data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic from real customers. The positive reviews are detailed, specific, and span several years. The negative reviews highlight consistent issues with post-sale customer service responsiveness and follow-through, particularly for online/remote orders and warranty-type issues. The business seems competent for local, in-person projects but struggles with remote support.

negative_evidence: Failed to follow through on a promised replacement for a damaged screen
Poor response to installation issue (Velcro screens falling off)
positive_evidence: Worked with customer to correct a size error at no extra cost (implied)

authentic_signals: Specific project details (seeded glass, Victorian home, frameless shower doors)
Mentions of staff names (Jerry, Chris, Jonathan)
Customers mention price comparisons with competitors
complaint_patterns: Issues with product quality/damage on delivery
data.discrepancy_explanation: Moderate discrepancy between Google (4.7) and Yelp (3.8). This is common as Yelp often has a lower average rating and may attract more critical reviews. The gap is not extreme enough to suggest manipulation, but indicates a difference in customer experience or review platform dynamics.

reviews.text: Great service. Better prices! I needed 6 replacement panes of seeded glass for my cabinets. First place I called was $1200. Just the glass, no installation. I knew that was wrong. Hurst Glass was $450. Big difference. My panes were ready in less than a week. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Susan Harper

reviews.text: I have used this business now to repair a torn screen door and window on 2 different occasions. They were awesome both times! I was so surprised at how affordable it was and kicked myself for waiting as long as I did for the repair. One company quoted me over half more than the cost was with Hurst screen and repair. They did an incredible job and even helped me with loading. Great company, quality repairs, and absolutely no hidden costs!!!
reviews.author: Mandy Ebner

reviews.text: Hurst glass is fantastic! They came out and replaced all our screens and I couldn’t be more pleased with how everything was handled from start to finish. I compared prices with several other local glass companies and their prices were the best. Jerry was incredibly professional setting up my appointment and the technician did an excellent job, fast and efficiently. Strongly recommend them for all of your glass and screen needs!
reviews.author: Jennifer Sweeney

reviews.text:
These guys replaced our old OLD (broken) framed shower door with a modern one and the result is just amazing.  I wish I had some horrid "before" pictures to show, but after 25 years, the hinge had broken and the door was completely inoperable.  We wanted bright brass hardware, which turns out to be a little uncommon.  We got quotes from another vendor who, it seemed, really didn't want the job and complained about how hard it would be, how difficult it was to get bright brass and offered a number of very unattractive alternatives.

Jonathan from Hurst Glass, on the other hand, just said "no problem, I'll need to use some heavy duty hinges."  The price was great, the installation made exactly when promised and it looks even better than I'd dreamed.  In fact, the result is just so beautiful and Jonathan was so professional that we decided to immediately replace the other shower door in the house and did so. The doors are beautiful, work perfectly and SO update the look of the bathroom.  I cannot recommend these guys too highly!
reviews.author: Nancy Miracle

reviews.text: Chris and the team did a great job replacing all my windows and adding 80% solar screens. Very happy with their work. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: I have been using this company for many years. I replaced all of the windows in my 1897 Victorian home with their glass. They always get the measurements correct, they package the glass quite well so I can get it home safely, the pricing is very reasonable, their product is twice as good as low as an example, and their people are very courteous and accommodating. as a contractor, we have also use them on our jobs per shower glass as an example and they do a great job. I can’t say enough good things about this outfit.
reviews.author: JB

reviews.text: My wife and I ordered some new replacement screens for our daughter’s home, I measured incorrectly and the screens did not fit. The folks at Hurst Glass and Screen worked with us to get the right size, they gave us 2 screens that were the perfect fit. My thanks to Jerry and his team for all they did and I highly recommend using this business.
reviews.author: Gene Alexander

reviews.text: Hurst Glass & Screen did a standup job installing a beautiful sliding glass shower door in my home. Shout out to Jonathan for being so communicative and professional throughout the process.
reviews.author: Caitlin Sweet

reviews.text:
My rating is based on their online customer service. In my second custom screen order (first order was fine), the package was delivered and the screen frame was broken and bent. I know it's not their fault because it most likely happened during delivery. My frustration is when I emailed them several times and the person I contacted eventually said they would send a new screen. I waited for two weeks and sent several emails but no response. I've called the store several times and the person I talked to says they don't handle online orders and they will try to notify the person that manages online orders and it's been over a month. I had to order the screen from another place and asked them to send me a refund but still no answer. I don't like leaving negative reviews but I felt like my order wasn't handled correctly and still have not received my refund.

Update: their response saying I never responded to them is inaccurate. I provided them a screenshot of the five email replies that were sent (to the same email they are now reaching out back to me with) asking for status on my replacement order. I understand this may not had been intentional but this was my experience. I ended up having to initiate a claim with my credit card company to obtain my refund.
reviews.author: Steven Huynh

reviews.text:
Great product, great service, reliable delivery, and amazingly kind people. What more can I say?

I ordered a dozen custom-size screens online from Hurst Glass & Screen. I live in Half Moon Bay, CA, and we'd just purchased a funky house with odd-sized windows. I'd never ordered window screens before, but Hurst was highly rated, and they had an easy-to-use online ordering system. All I had to do was get the screen measurements right.

Easier said than done.

A well-packed and well-cushioned box of screens of various sizes arrived on time on my doorstep, all sized exactly as I had ordered. The quality of the metal, the strength of the screens, and the placement of the ram clips and tabs were all perfect.

Except ... I had incorrectly measured my bathroom windows, and the screens were too small. 10 out of 12 isn't bad for a rookie, but I still had two bathroom windows I couldn't open without letting bugs in.

So I emailed Hurst Glass & Screen, explained my mistake, and asked if they would offer me a discount on a replacement screen.

They did one better. Here's what they wrote back to me:
"We all make mistakes. If you provide the new measurements, we can send you two new screens at no cost. We don't need the other screens back."

Amazing. Makes me wish I had more windows so I could send them more business. Can't say enough good things about them. I recommend them highly!!
reviews.author: Joshua Reynolds

reviews.text: Hurst Glass did an amazing job on our Frameless Shower door!  They were very responsive and installed on the day they said they would! I would highly recommend them and will use them in the future!
reviews.author: MG DS

reviews.text: Hurst Glass is the BEST glass company around! They reglazed ALL the windows at my home and it looks gorgeous! This saves me THOUSANDS over full replacement. They also came back and replaced the glass on another broken window for me and fixed a window with some fallen beading at a different house. They are the only ones I will call for work on my windows :)
reviews.author: Just_ Cuz

reviews.text: The windows in our house are super old so it was no surprise that when our puppy lunged at the kitchen window at a squirrel he broke the window.  We had someone else come out and quote us at $1000 to completely replace one window.  I definitely don't have that kind of cash right now.  So when a friend recommended Hurst Glass and Screen I was skeptical that they could actually just replace the glass.  Jerry and Johnathan were awesome, friendly, and professional!  Johnathan was able to just replace the glass in what felt like a matter of minutes and at a fraction of the cost.  I couldn't believe it!  I am so grateful that my friend let me know about Hurst Glass and Screen!  I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Jill Burnett

reviews.text: When your mom has a screen door that's older than you are and the screen in said door is the same age as the door you drop the screen off with these guys and they'll make it new again. Good price too! Thank y'all!
reviews.author: Amy Lively

reviews.text: Love the screens but they were put up with Velcro and they are falling off.  Response from them is very spotty at best and it has been a week
reviews.author: Tim Huffman

reviews.text: Jonathan came out to give me an estimate on my shower and some faulty windows. He was super honest and told me I don’t need my windows replaced, just some caulking on them. Saved me a ton. Will definitely be going back for all my glass needs and recommending them to others. Honesty is the best policy and will grow your business exponentially.
reviews.author: Keara

reviews.text:
This is our go to place for any window screen repairs or new ones. Jerry does an excellent job. I highly recommend Hurst Glass and Screen.
Thanks.

Veronica
reviews.author: Veronica McLaughlin

reviews.text: Another great job completed by Hurst Glass and Screen. We have been using these guys for our home needs since the early 80's. Replacement screens and glass for both our home and our rental property. So happy with their work and always on time and all the staff knowledgeable about their products and friendly to work with. It's nice to know who to call should the need arise. Thanks guys and keep up the great work!
reviews.author: Teresa Bailey
